definition: Natural-origin structural network constituents, including chemically modified natural backbones.
boundary: All structural network-forming constituents natural-origin; cargo/non-network fillers alone do not change origin.
caveat: Retain existing origin decisions; this pass does not re-audit every source network role.

definition: A structural network containing both natural-origin and synthetic-origin constituents.
boundary: At least one structural component of each origin; not a catch-all for nanoparticles or multiple natural polymers.
caveat: No arbitrary mass-fraction threshold.

boundary: All structural network-forming chains/bridges synthetic-origin; do not infer origin from drug cargo.
caveat: Retain the accepted designed-structural-peptide convention.

definition: No separately coded material-associated bioactive cue under the retained rule.
boundary: Not synonymous with a biologically inert matrix; external LPS or other priming belongs to Activation stimulus.
caveat: Known retained exceptions, including plain P04 GelMA B/A, remain disclosed, not silently repaired.

boundary: Material-associated immune cue without independently substantiated direct regenerative evidence meeting class C.
caveat: Lack of qualifying evidence is not proof of no regenerative biology. Do not assign from the target cytokine value.

boundary: Both roles need formulation/cue-specific evidence. Direct repair-cell function or supported regenerative mechanism is required; M2 markers, compatibility or downstream wound closure alone are insufficient.
caveat: Machine string is retained for compatibility; it does not assert literal growth-factor cargo. EV presence alone is not sufficient.

boundary: Direct regenerative signal meeting the codebook evidence criterion, without a substantiated combined anti-inflammatory/pro-resolving role.
caveat: P21/P27/P28 conditional decisions are retained; not a universal chemically pure growth-factor class.

definition: Combined pro- and anti-inflammatory material cues.
boundary: Material-associated cue system with both roles; external activation alone does not establish a pro-inflammatory material cue.
caveat: Legacy D memberships are not fully re-certified; P44 non-EV D rationale remains an exception. Do not merge with B or C solely for sample count.

boundary: Material-associated pro-inflammatory function under the retained assignment convention; not external LPS.
caveat: Rare class retained. P47 PMB-related ambiguity remains documented.

definition: Light-initiated crosslinking of the assayed network.
boundary: Light must form the relevant hydrogel network, not merely sterilise, image, or act on already formed material.
caveat: For composite/multi-step systems preserve a source-supported dominant-network convention; do not select whichever label improves prediction.

definition: Physical self-assembly / physical gelation, including temperature-triggered physical network assembly.
boundary: Classify the assayed continuous hydrogel network, not fabrication of an embedded carrier. Documented physical assembly without a required light-, enzyme-, or covalent-crosslinking step belongs here.
caveat: Authorised merge: thermal_gelation -> physical_self_assembly for P05 C and the C4 HPA matrix. Do not generalise from heating alone to every thermal chemical reaction.

definition: Enzyme-initiated or enzyme-mediated network formation under the existing project convention.
boundary: Includes thrombin-triggered fibrin formation. Mere enzymatic degradation is not enzymatic crosslinking.
caveat: Do not infer this label from the presence of an enzyme cargo.

definition: Other chemical / mixed / not-more-specifically-resolved crosslink route.
boundary: Residual code when the assayed network is not assigned to the physical, photo- or enzyme-led categories; genipin-containing P05 formulations remain here.
caveat: This is an explicit residual category, not a mechanistically homogeneous class. Distinguish chemical/mixed/uncertain subtypes in provenance, not new predictor levels.

boundary: Retained evidence rubric sum 3–5; model input is categorical, not the score.
caveat: P05 cross-target high/medium discrepancy is explicitly retained.

boundary: Retained evidence rubric sum 6–8; model input is categorical, not the score.
caveat: Do not relabel by cytokine outcomes or by making two target files numerically match.

boundary: Retained evidence rubric sum 0–2; model input is categorical, not the score.
caveat: Missing historical component scores are a traceability limit; no score reconstructed.

boundary: Assay uses RAW264.7; not a general mouse-macrophage category.
caveat: All four C4 case records stay RAW264_7. Source Methods/Results conflict is retained as an assumption.

definition: Broad murine primary-cell or in-vivo context.
boundary: Residual murine primary/context category where the retained specific-cell categories are not used; exposure mode distinguishes culture from animal tissue/systemic measurements.
caveat: Does not prove a macrophage-only origin of blood/tissue cytokines. Broad/specific BMDM overlap remains declared until an approved global parent rule.

definition: THP-1 cell line / THP-1-derived macrophage model.
boundary: Distinguish from primary human monocyte-derived macrophages.
caveat: No merge based solely on shared human origin.

boundary: Primary human donor-cell model, not THP-1.
caveat: Low count and one-study support retained; no biologically incorrect merge with RAW or THP-1.

boundary: Specific BMDM category takes precedence over broad murine context where a specific assignment has been retained.
caveat: Primary branch leaves singleton TNF-0139 unchanged. Existing broad P05 primary convention is not uniformly fine-grained; optional parent-merge sensitivity only.

boundary: LPS without a co-specified IFN-gamma activation protocol.
caveat: Do not borrow LPS from another assay in the paper.

definition: No specified activating pretreatment; basal assay.
boundary: Use only when absence of activation is supported, not when the source is unclear.
caveat: Unclear is not basal.

boundary: Matched exogenous activation/priming by IL-4 and/or IL-13.
caveat: Delivered cytokine cargo belongs to Bioactive cue, not automatically to Activation stimulus.

boundary: The matched assay uses both agents.
caveat: Do not collapse to LPS merely because the class is small.

boundary: A known non-listed stimulus/context, including the retained magnetic-field, LTA or infection contexts.
caveat: Heterogeneous residual category; record exact stimulus in provenance. Not equivalent to unclear.

boundary: Source does not establish a classified stimulus for the matched assay.
caveat: Not a missing numeric cell; not basal; do not infer from model outcomes.

definition: Cells seeded on or directly contacting a hydrogel surface.
boundary: Source establishes surface contact rather than merely sharing a culture well.
caveat: Not equivalent to encapsulation.

definition: Exposure to hydrogel extract, eluate or released medium.
boundary: Cells receive prepared material-derived liquid rather than a specified intact-gel surface or transwell arrangement.
caveat: Retain C4 extraction inference as inference; do not call it explicitly established.

definition: Three-dimensional cell residence within a hydrogel / accepted porous scaffold arrangement.
boundary: Includes the retained P15 assembled-microgel-scaffold convention; not animal in vivo.
caveat: Keep a provenance note distinguishing true encapsulation from porous scaffold residence.

definition: In-vivo tissue or systemic cytokine endpoint.
boundary: Sample obtained from a living-organism experiment, not cells inside an in-vitro gel.
caveat: Do not pool into direct contact or encapsulated 3D to raise support.

boundary: A specified physical separation/indirect set-up; distinguish from a pre-collected extract.
caveat: No automatic merge with extract/eluate.

boundary: Protocol does not establish a more specific mode.
caveat: No assignment of direct contact from mere co-culture wording.
